_comment: Only paper_run_ids feed paper outputs. pilot_run_ids are scored with --set pilot into results/derived/pilot. excluded_run_ids are known and never scored (pilot1: old prompt, 800 token limit, mostly call errors). Any other run id in raw is reported and not scored.
_comment_ext: ext_run_ids (R1 committee extensions) are known but never scored by score.py, fit_wbayes.py, make_tables.py or committee_fixes*.py; only analysis/ext_analysis.py reads the five main ext ids. Adding them here only silences the UNKNOWN warning; main1 outputs are byte-identical.
